meta.cadence: GitHub Actions snapshot (not a guaranteed 15-minute tick; cron can drift or pause). STALE banner if snapshot age > 2 hours. On-page LIVE pulse: browser JSON-RPC to public Solana RPC (publicnode, mainnet-beta fallback) for slot/epoch/TPS at most every 60s. Snapshot values shown as NOT LIVE if RPC fails. Never invented.

live_pulse.label: LIVE / on-page-now vs snapshot generated_at
live_pulse.fail: NOT LIVE — last snapshot values; never invented
live_pulse.note: Browser JSON-RPC. publicnode first because api.mainnet-beta.solana.com 403s GitHub Pages Origin; publicnode CORS *. Same two keyless endpoints as generate.py. At most every 60s. Not a GitHub Actions tick.

dex.change_7d_meaning: percent change of 24h DEX volume vs the 24h from 7 days ago (not 7d-total vs prior 7d)

rwa.source: defillama.protocols chainTvls.Solana where category in {RWA, RWA Lending}

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

sampled.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.
sampled.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
sampled.sampled_runrate_note: sum(meta.fee) 0.0322 SOL over 9968s × 86400. ESTIMATED 24h in-protocol fees from the stratified sample, not a ledger.
sampled.note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2240 all-tx, n_nonvote=964, window_seconds=9968. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2240 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9968s.

economics.median_tx_fee_note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2240 all-tx, n_nonvote=964, window_seconds=9968. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2240 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9968s.
economics.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.

jito.tips_24h_note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000347 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1547) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito.sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 48565 USD; at p95 floor → 914872 USD.
jito.sensitivity_note: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 48565 USD; at p95 floor → 914872 USD.

jito_runrate_not_rev.note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000347 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1547) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito_runrate_not_rev.label: INVALID as a 24h aggregate — tip_floor is per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx

economics.rev_definition: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV.
economics.rev_kind: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-09-07: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-09-07
economics.rev_sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 48565 USD; at p95 floor → 914872 USD.

items.title:
Rent reduction is live on mainnet-beta.

Step 1 of SIMD-0437 activated at epoch 1028, the first of five feature gates on the road to cutting Solana's storage cost per byte by 90% overall.

Step 1 drops lamports per byte 6,960 → 6,333. Each remaining gate activates only after state growth checks out at the current level. We are stepping down to the final 696 safely, not on a fixed schedule. Follow here for an accurate timeline.

A safeguard gate (SIMD-0438) can restore the legacy value if state growth becomes a problem.

items.title:
Agenda

Key events:  

> V2 RC1 released 
> V1.2 released. Key features. 
> RC2 in preparation. 

We are addressing your feedback. Key improvements:  

- web3js v3 support 
- Instruction-handler inline policy: addressed a raised concern that v2 switched instruction wrappers to #[inline(always)] (from v1's #[inline(never)]) by making the policy configurable (#4975) 
- Introspection support for Sysvar<SysvarInstructions> (#4944) Please share further feedback and we'll consider it 

Tooling/platform/misc improvements:  

- Toolchain and AVM: progressed the platform-tools update 
- We'll be adding AI-usage guidance to the contributing guidelines Txv1 rollout   

Roadmap:
  
- RC2 for V2 - expected within September 
- Complete the txv1 rollout

official.title:
Rent reduction is live on mainnet-beta.

Step 1 of SIMD-0437 activated at epoch 1028, the first of five feature gates on the road to cutting Solana's storage cost per byte by 90% overall.

Step 1 drops lamports per byte 6,960 → 6,333. Each remaining gate activates only after state growth checks out at the current level. We are stepping down to the final 696 safely, not on a fixed schedule. Follow here for an accurate timeline.

A safeguard gate (SIMD-0438) can restore the legacy value if state growth becomes a problem.

- RC2 for V2 - expected within September 
- Complete the txv1 rollout

timeline_public.item: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.”
solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic” remains a listing-token write-up for SIMD-525 (SIMD-0525).
SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Observed mean slot ~317 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC.
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether the 300 ms gate (effective epoch 1024 when activated at epoch-1023 start) is live once that epoch starts.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (250/200) get Feature accounts on mainnet.
Do not treat observed slot ms as activation proof.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.
